resources.string: The most stable connection. Needs a cable and \"USB debugging\" turned on once.
Wireless. Must be on the same network as the PC; asks for a pairing code the first time.
Not found. Is Divit open on the PC with \"Allow Wi-Fi connections\" checked? Are you on the same network? If not, enter the address below.
This is the tablet\'s own address. Enter the PC\'s address (there may be an IP conflict).
The code shown on the PC will be asked on first connection.
On the next Wi-Fi connection you will need to enter the 6-digit code shown on the PC again.
The tablet is only used as a drawing surface; dimming the screen saves battery.

USB (one-time setup on the tablet):
1. Turn on Developer options: Settings → About tablet → Software information → tap "Build number" 7 times. Enter your PIN if asked; "Developer mode has been turned on" appears.
2. Turn on USB debugging: Settings → Developer options (at the bottom of the list) → turn on "USB debugging".
3. Open Divit on the PC, then connect the tablet to the PC with a USB cable (a data cable, not a charge-only one).
4. The tablet asks "Allow USB debugging?": tick "Always allow from this computer" and tap Allow.
From then on just plug in the cable: the PC sets up the connection by itself. USB debugging lets only the computers you allowed talk to the tablet; you can turn it off again in Developer options.

Wi-Fi: in the Divit window on the PC, turn on "Allow Wi-Fi connections". The PC address and the pairing code are shown there. If the window is closed, click the Divit icon in the system tray.

The Back button leaves the drawing screen and closes the connection.
Divit must be open on the PC and the tablet connected over USB.
PC found at a new address: %1$s
Enter the 6-digit code shown on the PC.
The pairing is no longer valid; pair again.
Divit is not running on the PC, or USB is not ready.
Wi-Fi is off on the PC — turn on \"Allow Wi-Fi connections\" in the Divit window on the PC.
%1$s does not answer — is the address right? Does the firewall allow Divit?
The Divit version on the PC is not compatible. Update both apps.
The PC you paired with is not at this address: a different computer answered.

Pairing failed: too many wrong codes. Wait 30 seconds and try again.
The code is shown in the Divit window on the PC (\"Wi-Fi and startup\"). It is asked only once for this PC.
Wrong code. Enter the current code shown on the PC again.
